# temps_http_check (Resource)

A credential expiry check of a project: an `http` check calls an issuer's API with a stored credential, a `local` check reads expiring items (certificates, keys, tokens) from a project secret or variable on the Temps host and never sends the value anywhere.

Import with `<project_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_http_check" "api_auth" {
  project_id       = temps_project.web.id
  name             = "API token still valid"
  kind             = "http"
  interval_seconds = 3600
  credential       = var.api_token
  spec = jsonencode({
    url               = "https://api.example.com/me"
    method            = "get"
    accepted_statuses = [200]
    credential_header = "Authorization"
    credential_prefix = "Bearer "
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the check.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `credential` (String, Sensitive) Credential sent to the issuer. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Run the check on its interval.
- `env_var_id` (Number) ID of the environment variable holding it.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between runs.
- `kind` (String) Type of check. One of `http`, `local`.
- `local` (String) Settings of a `local` check, for example `jsonencode({ warning_days = [30, 7] })`. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `secret_id` (Number) ID of the project secret holding the credential or item.
- `spec` (String) HTTP recipe of an `http` check: method, URL, headers and how to read the expiry. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.

### Read-Only

- `automatic_provider` (String) Issuer Temps recognised automatically.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<id>`.
- `last_checked_at` (String) When the check last ran.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_http_check.api_auth 8/6
```
